name: vinyl-simulator
description: Interactive 3D vinyl turntable that plays local audio through a virtual groove.

scripts.check:physics: tsc --ignoreConfig src/physics/platterMotor.ts src/physics/pitch.ts src/physics/tonearm.ts src/physics/groove.ts src/physics/platterMotor.check.ts --outDir node_modules/.tmp/check-physics --module commonjs --target es2022 && node node_modules/.tmp/check-physics/platterMotor.check.js
scripts.check:dsp: tsc --ignoreConfig src/physics/platterMotor.ts src/physics/pitch.ts src/physics/groove.ts src/physics/tonearm.ts src/physics/wowFlutter.ts src/audio/engine/grooveBuffer.ts src/audio/engine/resampler.ts src/audio/engine/riaa.ts src/audio/engine/cartridge.ts src/audio/engine/stylus.ts src/audio/engine/discShape.ts src/audio/engine/surface.ts src/audio/engine/rumble.ts src/audio/engine/hum.ts src/audio/engine/stylusTip.ts src/audio/engine/recordCondition.ts src/audio/engine/cutting.ts src/audio/engine/cutLayout.ts src/audio/engine/deckEngine.ts src/audio/engine/deckEngine.check.ts --outDir node_modules/.tmp/check-dsp --module commonjs --target es2022 && node node_modules/.tmp/check-dsp/audio/engine/deckEngine.check.js
